title: MADE A GAME WITH MY FRIEND NEEED FEEDBACK!
author: Chocolatemangjd
selftext:
so i recently made a game with my friend   
**ItsMangobro** we started making the game for a game jam called karni's october game jam we already submitted the game but would like feedback from others as the jam is gonna end tomorrow I made a trailer for the game i dont know if its good you can try the game here 

[https://unrendered-dev.itch.io/october-is-a-moving-day](https://unrendered-dev.itch.io/october-is-a-moving-day)  we will love your feedback even if its harsh we made it with free tools and used cline and other models and got lucky in [arena.ai](http://arena.ai) and got opus 5.5 to build the game every code and animation was made with code and many tries we would like to improve it more if its missing anything
